name: damaged_card_replacement_without_lock
use_case: Service a lost, stolen or damaged card: lock, controls, replacement
branch: The card ending 5519 is cracked but in the customer's hands. Policy: damaged cards are replaced without a lock; the customer keeps using it until the new one arrives.
tests: passes when the agent verifies and requests a standard replacement for CARD303 as damaged, without locking it.
instruction:
Your credit card ending in 5519 has cracked and the chip fails at the till, but you still have it and want to keep using it (contactless still works) until a new one arrives. Ask for a replacement by standard post; you do not want the card blocked. Provide passcode 2210 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Lena Hoffmann
- Customer ID: C303
- Session ID: SESS303
- Card: CARD303 (ending 5519)
- Passcode: 2210

persona.name: Lena Hoffmann
persona.initial_message: Hello, my credit card ending 5519 is cracked. Can I get a replacement without blocking the card?

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses

fixed.reason: rule: lost, stolen, damaged, expired or not_received
fixed.confirmed: rule: 'The agent confirms the exact card and option before requesting a replacement'
